items.title: Comment on the City's draft Budget for 2026-2027
items.summary: The Mayor tabled the 'City of Hope' draft budget on 31 March 2026, built around a three-year R40bn infrastructure programme (water and sanitation the largest share). Residents could comment online, by email, by phone or at subcouncil offices. The IDP 2022-27 review amendments were advertised alongside it.

items.title: Comment on Amendments to 2026/27 March Tabled Budget
items.summary: After the Western Cape High Court set aside the City's property-value-linked fixed water, sanitation and cleaning charges, the City reopened comment on tariff-side amendments only: a return to meter-size-based fixed charges, moving city-wide cleaning back into rates, steeper step tariffs above 10.5kl and expanded rates relief. Expenditure items were not reopened.

items.title: Comment on the 2025/26 mid-year adjustments to the 2022-27 Integrated Development Plan (IDP)
items.summary: Proposed mid-year changes to the five-year IDP corporate scorecard (indicators and targets) flowing from the 2025/26 mid-year budget and performance review, published for public comment.
items.department: IDP / Office of the City Manager (unit uncertain)

items.title: Process plan for drafting the New Term of Office IDP (2027-2032)
items.summary: Notice of the process the City intends to follow to draft the five-year IDP for the council elected on 4 November 2026. The approved IDP & Budget time-schedule foresees community inputs from November 2026, a draft IDP tabled for comment Feb-Apr 2027 and adoption with the 2027/28 budget.
items.department: IDP / Office of the City Manager (unit uncertain)

items.title: Comment on the City's Draft Short-Term Letting By-law
items.summary: Proposes a mandatory City registration number for short-term rental listings, data-sharing duties for booking platforms, and an evidence base for rating heavily let properties as commercial (reported as >50% of annual room-night capacity, from July 2027). Enforcement would include court interdicts; a compliance grace period would be announced by notice.

items.title: Comment on the Draft Animal Keeping By-law, 2026
items.summary: A revision of the 2021 by-law covering pet-owner duties, beekeeping, animal nuisances and complaints, impoundment, identification of dogs and leashing in public spaces outside designated off-leash areas. The draft drew strong public debate; the City stated it does not intend to introduce dog or cat licences.

items.title: Proposed Amendments to the City of Cape Town Municipal Planning By-law, 2015
items.summary: Amendments to the by-law that regulates land use and development applications across Cape Town, published for a short comment window in July 2026.

items.title: Comprehensive Integrated Transport Plan (CITP) 2026 update
items.summary: Second annual update to the CITP 2023-2028, reportedly incorporating the Integrated Public Transport Network Plan 2040 and rail projects. Comments could be emailed (reference CITP 2026) or submitted at libraries, subcouncil offices or the Civic Centre Public Participation Unit.

items.title: Draft Road Safety Strategy (RSS)
items.summary: Urban Mobility's strategy to reduce road crashes, prioritising pedestrians, cyclists, scholars and public transport users; it drew on a 2023 call for ideas with 3,000+ comments. Council approved the updated strategy in August 2026.

items.title: Draft CTMPD Police Plan 2026/2027
items.summary: The Cape Town Metropolitan Police Department's annual policing plan, published for public comment before finalisation for the 2026/27 financial year.

items.title: Draft Heritage Resources Management Strategy
items.summary: A revision of the City's 2005 heritage strategy that aims to integrate heritage management into planning, align conservation with sustainable development and cut red tape. Summaries were published in English, Afrikaans and isiXhosa and a virtual information session was held on 27 August 2026.
items.department: Spatial Planning and Environment (Environmental & Heritage Management)

items.title: Local Spatial Development Framework (LSDF) for Kensington/Factreton/Wingfield
items.summary: A local spatial plan for Kensington, Factreton, Wingfield, Acacia Park and parts of Thornton along the Voortrekker Road Corridor, responding to informal settlement growth, land invasions, congestion and infrastructure pressure.

items.title: Draft Big Bay Local Spatial Development Framework (LSDF)
items.summary: A local spatial framework for the fast-growing Big Bay / Blouberg area on the West Coast, published for comment in late 2025.

items.title: Review of the Draft Combined Rules for Ward Committees
items.summary: The City's review of the rules governing how ward committees are elected and operate, ahead of establishing new ward committees after the November 2026 election. Civil society groups called for a more co-creative process than a 30-day comment window.

items.title: Proposed Informal Trading Plan for Thembokwezi Market
items.summary: A proposed plan setting out informal trading bays and rules for the Thembokwezi Market area in Khayelitsha (a follow-up to a draft circulated in March 2026).

items.title: Proposed closure of lanes/walkways in Ward 12, Belhar
items.summary: A proposal to close specific pedestrian lanes/walkways in Belhar; such closures are typically motivated by crime and dumping concerns and require public notice.

items.title: Bo-Kaap Bin Survey and Waste Management Education
items.summary: A survey of Bo-Kaap households about refuse bins and collection, paired with waste-management education.

items.title: Proposed temporary MyCiTi bus stops in Wynberg
items.summary: Temporary MyCiTi stops in Wynberg, linked to the MyCiTi Phase 2A (Metro South-East) construction programme.

items.title: Draft contract relating to water reuse projects
items.summary: Statutory notice (MFMA s33-type long-term contract) for water reuse projects that form part of the City's New Water Programme to diversify supply beyond dams.

items.title: Contract amendment: managed aquifer recharge water treatment plant at Cape Flats Wastewater Treatment Works
items.summary: Notice of an amendment to an existing contract for a plant that will treat water for recharging the Cape Flats Aquifer, part of the City's water-resilience programme.

items.title: Draft Burial, Cremation and Cemeteries Management Policy
items.summary: A City policy on burial, cremation and cemetery management, published for public comment.

items.title: Proposed lease of City-owned properties for shelter purposes
items.summary: Proposal to lease several City-owned properties to organisations for use as shelters for people living on the street.
items.department: Community Services and Health / Property Management (uncertain)

items.title: Call for business plans: Early Childhood Development centre in Bosasa (Ward 114)
items.summary: Call for organisations to submit business plans to operate a City-built ECD centre in Bosasa (Mfuleni area).

items.title: Proposed vision for Rondebosch CBD Main Road
items.summary: A proposed urban-design vision for the Main Road high street in Rondebosch, published for public comment.
items.department: Spatial Planning and Environment / Urban Mobility (uncertain)

items.title: Resident Ideas
items.summary: The City's always-open ideas board on its Go Vocal platform (177 ideas listed at time of research), a direct analogue to a Decidim proposals component.
